cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Fluent in Nonsense
cards.instruction: Perform complete mastery of the strange logic while inventing each rule only when it becomes necessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we price this bottled cloud, measure its third elbow. Bring the result to me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm your new assistant. It only has two. May I open the bottle?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may address it first. 'Professor' is sufficient; the third elbow appears only for respectful staff.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Professor. It's raining now. Shall I stop?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Continue. Those are its credentials, and I decide when they're sufficient. Count ten drops through the glass and write the price. Any more and we'll be selling an overqualified cloud.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 treats B2 opening question as limited permission for a respectful ritual; A5 reserves authority over credentials and invents a pricing rule from B4 rain.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 two elbows causes A3 title solution; B4 rain causes A5 credential pricing. The third elbow is displaced by a new claimed measure rather than actually found.

relationship.evidence: B2 new assistant asks before opening; B4 checks whether the surprising rain should stop. A3 and A5 direct both practical questions.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4 rain into credentials with a count limit, developing A authority from procedure to valuation in the same sale.

specificity.evidence: A1 cloud pricing, B2 assistant and A5 glass establish the task, roles and observation without inventing an opened bottle.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 overqualification follows Professor and credentials rather than an unrelated punchline; the price calculation remains deliberately absurd.

coach2.inferred: A performs confident mastery by substituting a new valuation rule when the title yields rain.
coach2.missing: No essential physical fact is missing; price need not be scientifically derivable in this premise.
coach2.firstDefect: None blocking; third-elbow measure is abandoned through A claimed superior interpretation.

A1-B2.evidence: B2 reports inability to perform A1 three-elbow measure and proposes opening.

B2-A3.evidence: A3 permits an alternative to B2 opening and supplies a title rule for the missing elbow.

A3-B4.evidence: B4 performs A3 address and asks whether to stop after rain starts.

B4-A5.evidence: A5 orders continuation of B4 rain, interprets it as credentials and sets a count for pricing.
